notes.title: DashFire Public Beta: OPEN NOW!
notes.content:
[p]Hello all! [/p][p][/p][p]The DashFire team has been hard at work for the last 3 months creating new content for all of you, and today is the day where we feel comfortable getting the community involved in the testing![/p][p][/p][p]So, what's new?[/p][p][/p][h2]Features:[/h2][list][*][p]Server Browser: We heard you loud and clear, while DashFire is fun with friends, sometimes branching out and playing with others is fun too![/p][/*][*][p]Text Chat: Chat with other people in the lobby through the in game text chat![/p][/*][*][p]New Weapons: Two new weapons for you to play with, a baseball bat with a powerful charge attack, and dual SMGs to melt your opponents at close range![/p][/*][*][p]New maps: We decided to scrap the old stuff and start fresh. Play on two brand new maps![/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of Quality of Life Changes: We really wanted to hone in on the game feel of DashFire, and we've done loads of tweaks and additions to get it to a state that feels even better to play than before![/p][/*][*][p]Art Overhaul: We've decided to go higher-poly, aiming for a more early-2000s look, we hope you enjoy the new changes![/p][/*][*][p]And many more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]How To Enter the Playtest:[/h2][list][*][p]Right click on DashFire in your Steam library[/p][/*][*][p]Click on Prefrences[/p][/*][*][p]Go to Betas[/p][/*][*][p]Click on the Beta Participation dropdown, and select beta - The beta branch for testing DashFire[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope you're as excited as we are to get all these new features out to the public for wide-spread playtesting![/p][p][/p][p]For your feedback, you can either post them here, on the Steam discussion board, or on our Discord Server that will be linked below and on the Steam Page![/p][p]
We hope to see you on the battlefield![/p][p]Team DashFire[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/2ERY8hJaCy"]https://discord.gg/2ERY8hJaCy[/url][/p]
